entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a jersey. It's the wrong size. Obviously.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. So it's a fit issue. Is it too loose, or perhaps too tight?
Yeah, it's way too tight. The sizing chart on your site is clearly useless.
I'm sorry to hear it didn't fit as you expected. We can definitely look into a return or an exchange for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Ugh, fine, let me find it. It's VF-994102.
Thank you. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see the Pro-Elite jersey, delivered on December 6th. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.

Alright, I've checked the policy. Since that jersey is a standard apparel item, it's covered by our 90-day return window. You're well within that timeframe, so I can process this for you right now. Would you prefer a refund or an exchange for a larger size?
Whatever. Just the refund. I'm done with this.

A refund it is. I've just initiated that for you and sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the jersey, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
